reason: Make descriptor, Line-MSHR, payload and WAD retirement independently explicit
before: Pins survive bank reads and response backpressure. Partial-sector readiness does not make a whole line valid, and old generations cannot access reused storage. after: For a tracked read, its requester descriptor and payload pin survive until the response is accepted by the L2-to-interconnect queue (or an internal response is consumed). Partial readiness and stale generations cannot authorize payload reuse. WB draining needs no new resident miss; eventual bank/lower service is assumed, not whole-GPU deadlock freedom.
